# Maintain the Work Graph

Use the repository's [editable playbook](../../../AI-INSTRUCTIONS-TEMPLATE.md)
and [command interface](../../../GRAPH_AGENT_MCP_PLAN.md). Read the active notes,
Base configuration, and current revisions before proposing edits.

Record facts locally on named records. Keep container status separate from
descendant counts. Treat sequence/readiness/recovery as advisory. Never infer
predecessor completion, successor invalidation, approval, waiver, or execution
from topology. Persist recommendations with scope, rank, reasons, and provenance.

Inspect the before/after preview and apply through the shared revision-checked
commands. Use Obsidian's native interface while the vault is open; offline
writes require the application closed. Preserve unknown fields, note bodies,
identities and history; review partial receipts instead of blindly retrying.

Graph maintenance permission is not production-action permission. This skill
does not grant deployment, flag-change, git push, or PR-merge authority.
